title: Coordinate expansion of covectors in the basis dx^β
statement:
For all P, n ∈ ℕ and every α ∈ Covector (Eucl P) n:
α = Σ_{β ∈ I(n,P)} α(e_β)·dx^β,
where I(n,P) = SimonMultiIndex n P is the finite type of order embeddings β : Fin n ↪o Fin P, α(e_β) = euclideanCovectorCoordinate α β = α(e_{β(0)},…,e_{β(n−1)}) with e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1, and dx^β = wedgeCovectors n (fun j => EuclideanSpace.proj (β j)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (α : Covector (Eucl P) n), α = ∑ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, euclideanCovectorCoordinate α β • wedgeCovectors n (fun j => EuclideanSpace.proj (β j))
